auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Postalytics API key used as the HTTP Basic username. Find it in the Connect section of your Postalytics account: https://docs.postalytics.com/getting-started/quick-start

actions.name: get_campaign
actions.description: Get basic details for one Postalytics campaign.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving a Postalytics campaign.

ContactListId.description: The contact list identifier used by the campaign.

anyOf.description: The direct-mail campaign name when available.

DirectMailName.description: The direct-mail campaign name when available.

anyOf.description: The campaign endpoint identifier when available.

EndPointId.description: The campaign endpoint identifier when available.

outputSchema.description: The basic campaign details returned by Postalytics.

actions.name: get_campaign_stats
actions.description: Get delivery and engagement statistics for one Postalytics campaign.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving Postalytics campaign statistics.

audience.description: The number of contacts targeted by the campaign.

conversions.description: The number of conversions attributed to the campaign.

created_date.description: The campaign creation timestamp returned by Postalytics.

delivered.description: The number of delivered mail pieces.

anyOf.description: The triggered-drip endpoint when available.

in_local_area.description: The number of mail pieces in the local delivery area.

in_transit.description: The number of mail pieces in transit.

is_live_mode.description: Whether the campaign is in live mode as a Postalytics numeric flag.

anyOf.description: The campaign name when available.

pageviews.description: The total number of tracked page views.

processed_for_delivery.description: The number of mail pieces processed for delivery.

returned.description: The number of returned mail pieces.

send_date.description: The campaign send timestamp returned by Postalytics.

anyOf.description: The front thumbnail URL when available.

thumbnail.description: The front thumbnail URL when available.

anyOf.description: The back thumbnail URL when available.

thumbnail_back.description: The back thumbnail URL when available.

unique_pageviews.description: The number of unique tracked page views.

unique_visitors.description: The number of unique tracked visitors.

items.description: A campaign record returned by Postalytics.

outputSchema.description: The campaign statistics records returned directly by Postalytics.
